comment: DRM configuration for a media item.

variables.name: scheme
variables.comment: The UUID of the protection scheme.

variables.name: licenseUri
variables.comment:
* Optional default DRM license server {@link Uri}. If {@code null} then the DRM license server
     * must be specified by the media.

variables.name: licenseRequestHeaders
variables.comment: The headers to attach to requests sent to the DRM license server.

variables.name: multiSession
variables.comment: Whether the DRM configuration is multi session enabled.

variables.name: playClearContentWithoutKey
variables.comment:
* Whether clear samples within protected content should be played when keys for the encrypted
     * part of the content have yet to be loaded.

variables.name: forceDefaultLicenseUri
variables.comment:
* Whether to force use of {@link #licenseUri} even if the media specifies its own DRM license
     * server URI.

variables.name: forcedSessionTrackTypes
variables.comment: * The types of tracks for which to always use a DRM session even if the content is unencrypted.

methods.name: public byte[] getKeySetId()
methods.comment: Returns the key set ID of the offline license.

methods.name: public Builder buildUpon()
methods.comment: Returns a {@link Builder} initialized with the values of this instance.
